source: The tier each Leeds statement gives under Protected Access Level 1, restated independently of leeds.json from 'Access Control - MASTER.xlsx': the statement's copyright status column on the DATA FOR DIGIRATI tab, and that column's PA1 cell in matrix v1.0. Under every other level the tier does not depend on the statement. Read by AccessConditionProfileTests (C#) and access-statements.test.mjs (the UI's JavaScript), so the two implementations are held to the same table.
